OZ_5

OZ_5 (= Pelliot tibétain 1252)
    photo
1. Content : Recto, Chinese sutra Guang-yin-jing. Verso, a medical text in Old Zhangzhung language.
2. Note : Scroll. Although the bottom edge is torn off, the text is complete with 47 lines of most probably Old Zhangzhung language, in total c. 850 syllables. Two more lines are written on the Chinese side, but their relation to the verso text is not clear.
3. References :
Takeuchi, Nagano, and Ueda (2001: Pl. 17-18)

Transliteration   (Change the Display Format)

(r1) $ / di ga rin mu sklungso de dis tho zo / wa ba kan gang kol kol de no ca
(r2) rin mu sklungs so di gun mu len ma ge mu lang ma shi min glung glung tIng ge
(r3) mu di gun [skar] len ma ge skar lang yer yu bya bya dod skar di gun [rvang(/rbang)] len /
(r4) ma ge [rvang(/rbang)] lang shi min yen yen ting [rvang(/rbang)] di gun we len ma ge we lang ma shi /
(r5) min ling ling rtsam ge we di gun ^ungg len ma ge ^ungg grang gra chil child
(r6) ting ge ryes se rind mu sklungs se [shed] ci pang ba kan nang ^a kar re yod de /
(r7) su ra spal bog phende kri ngo [dums(/ngums)] ge ba mins lyu lug lan lyam /
(r8) sleg sligs se mans ting legs ge ral [sangzhi(/sangni)] snis sa rla se /
(r9) ga rya no yeg rI ga rya ye rkyald tu mu kan ryugs mIn pham phang pu myung nIng
(r10) kar ro khvI ge kar ro di sad yul tu don dan tIng sklIngs na tse rhIng nIng kar ro mu ryvI
(r11) kar ro ge sheg kar bI sa la' [ca?] rzvald zangs se rtse ga tu ye tIng rchas gvIr gvar gra ryad tI [---]
(r12) tse myung nIng kar ro khvI mu kar de sad kar [splo] [yog(/^og)] shvIn dad gyungs nve rhIng
(r13) nIng kar ro mu ryvI kar ro ge shog kar pu dar ryug tos drum tam gver yars / khve tse myung
(r14) nIng kar ro khvI mu kar [dom] ro te sad kar / shIng grI tud glus ngag la land co pham[s] [thang?] / nu
(r15) tse mu ryvI kar re ge shag kar nul dI nal dI na ge le mIn cang stags zu tse myung
(r16) nIng kar ro khvI mu kar ro de sad kar skyIng wIng brang phang mu ce dIng lang grang gra nal nal
(r17) tIng gyIng ya tshe tshe mu ril tse kar tsug nI sla sa yun dubds tse [nal(/nlva)] le [rba(/rva)] /
(r18) gyungs pham se ^ur shvin ni ^va sla ma cI kang sla su rul brum
(r19) brum ryvid klas rad min ci bi ru ting kar gra tho yod de rhing ning kar
(r20) ro mu ryvi karo // ge shag kar shig gri rma yib yar yod mid tses / ta
(r21) dago [gu(/gung)] yig lig mu ting kar gra tho yod lin kar ryam ci zu /
(r22) kar klung gunkha sad ^am zhi sma dod ci ri ma glung glung dad sum
(r23) g[i] nab sa na [rbu(/rngu)] ri shvin shvin rye bi phig ge rvan rvin ni rug tsig mu wer
(r24) tsa med mu ting gya gya la gra na lang ^va rin des se dug tshum ni
(r25) sa [ryels(/zyels)] ting mu wer tsa se spal bun ti lang kang kham bungs se zhel stId /
(r26) ni su gru sub ryvi mes cod ni dis co tha par blu bla rgyags khus dun ni /
(r27) dis tuni tvi yul bung bung tsan sun nyer ni dis nyerd nI [rbu(/rvu)] rI gver gver dad [rban(/rvan)]
(r28) rhvan nI dis rhvand ni de zhi tag tog mu rlab ge tsa tsang sla rung se rma tshum ni /
(r29) tha ye / rang pa [gan(/shan)] nang kha se shed ci nam stan ci rva ^ur rvang nge se shed ci
(r30) rdogs yars se nam stand ci war ning rva ^ur rvang nge rtogs yars se tsve ning rva ^ur /
(r31) rvang nge rdogs yars se ^a tu rvang nge phyo ru se tsve ning ^a tu rvang nge phyo ru se zva dis
(r32) thore war ning rla ti rvang nge pham phrab se ye se shed ci tsve ning [dlya] ti rvang nge pham
(r33) phrab se nyu ngo ngo ge shel star zags lig zhil gyurd min nyan glangg glangg gyung
(r34) prand tag min zhil gro khyog shu gru gra [lang] shel nas [se] se [shed] bI rpyo rvang
(r35) nge rbyo du bruls se se shed bI kha kha zhIl wIg nI [cha nga] dag nI ne [ce(/me)]
(r36) smI la zhud [bo(/co)] rId khyo mIn dag go than zha gy[u]ng t[o]g [rkhyo(/rbyo)] rva tog ge [zhud] [ce(/me)]
(r37) cI za nI na zhI gyung ga tog ryvan / [wi] dog ge tI tu nI gyur ro kha kha no lu du
(r38) nI dag shIn kha no brang [rmo] nI zhIl rI wIg na tshang dag nI su ge bI ru ma
(r39) no she [sphed] gve ge nI su ge mang tsham pho war wans nI skying gying mu wer mu rhyols /
(r40) kye rin ge ge ba yo di ma 'ba khlab las de lag kvi wer ge tsa med mu /
(r41) kvi ting gya gya la gra ma rtse na tse wer rhyels na min yer yu [mnas(/mans)ma
(r42) zher zher rhyo rhugs sve ce / [rganse] gyag lang di ta rmin gyin rma rha gver dam /
(r43) das lang rhyels nyu ryvi nis ta rmin gyin chvi du yod min la snge ngag sum
(r44) ta rmin gyin nyu du yod min shel gver bund gver mu khekhe rhyels shel shag wo go
(r45) zangs shing pa cIg [khvi(/pi)] rin de no kvi [ting?] stogs rtsa rtsa sma lan myung ce shegs
(r46) kham bungs no na [mar(/mrva)] lars su rul bum bum skrad kla sha ge zas se mu [yardu]
(r47) run tshum min ken khe khe / gu[ra(/da)] rmin gyIn gi sa pa skar bag rlas min
